new: `let ty=if(f1=="\""){"s"}el if(f1=="["){"a"}el{"n"}; mtype=mtype+@(ty)` silently appends NOTHING (array length stays 0; mut-flag `ty` appends fine) — the two `ty` mut-flag ladders are kept

`let joined=if(prev==""){add}el if(add==""){prev}el{"\(prev),\(add)"}` then "[\(joined)]" prints a heap address (interpolating an expression-if-bound str, 127.7 class); the mut-flag nested if/el is kept (so cond-elif-chain is not applied there either)
soundex `result` reads its own length inside the padding loop and is sliced afterwards; s.builder has no len — kept as s.concat
charat/soundex tails `let r=mt ..; <s.concat(r;"")` left as written: the trailing copy is not a catalogue form and removing it would be a change beyond the pattern

fstr/pstr conditional `.0` suffix reads the value it rewrites; an expression-if would evaluate s.fromfloat twice — left as is
d3of/d4of are sequential guard returns (err-validate-early canonical form a); left as they are
main read loop `if(len(line)==0){}el{let trimmed=..; if(len(trimmed)==0)..}` kept nested: a binding sits between the two tests
